shots.visual_purpose: Establish an exciting December-morning mood with obvious visual puffery.
shots.voiceover_mapping: What if every December morning could roar with dinosaur excitement?
shots.visual_action: Morning light enters a seasonal room while a playful dinosaur-shaped shadow or graphic motif crosses the background; the product is not yet shown.
shots.framing_composition: Wide establishing composition with a center-safe area for the opening overlay.
shots.claim_proof_note: PUFFERY — the dinosaur shadow is an obvious mood metaphor and not a physical product feature.
shots.continuity_out: Seasonal light and color carry into the product reveal.
shots.capability_need: Seasonal environment motion or editor animation; exact text remains editor-owned.

shots.visual_purpose: Reveal the closed calendar as the source of the daily excitement.
shots.visual_action: The closed calendar settles into the seasonal setting with its real design readable and unobstructed.
shots.framing_composition: Centered hero framing with format-safe margins.
shots.claim_proof_note: PAGE-CLEARED product appearance; no added product feature.
shots.continuity_in: Matches S01 seasonal light and color.
shots.continuity_out: Calendar identity becomes the master reference for S03 onward.

shots.visual_purpose: Identify the product and anchor the 24-day mechanism.
shots.voiceover_mapping: The Dinosaur Adventure Countdown Calendar turns one Christmas gift into a 24-day ritual.
shots.visual_action: The full calendar remains centered while the numbered-door structure is clearly visible.
shots.framing_composition: Front-facing product hero with clear space for a short title overlay.
shots.continuity_in: Same product design, color, and intact-door state as S02.
shots.continuity_out: Prepares a closer read of door numbering.
shots.capability_need: Reference-consistent product motion; overlay stays editor-owned.

shots.visual_purpose: Make the 24 numbered doors immediately understandable.
shots.visual_action: A clean editor graphic traces representative door numbers across the real calendar without altering its layout.
shots.framing_composition: Close product crop with non-destructive graphic callouts.
shots.claim_proof_note: PAGE-CLEARED 24 numbered doors; graphic must match the source layout.
shots.continuity_out: Moves toward the first physical door interaction.

shots.voiceover_mapping: Open one numbered door each day and discover a unique dinosaur waiting inside—24 surprises, no repeats.
shots.visual_action: A generic hand opens one numbered door and reveals the first page-consistent dinosaur figure.
shots.framing_composition: Close-up of the door interaction with the product identity still recognizable.
shots.claim_proof_note: PAGE-CLEARED daily reveal and no-repeat promise; the generic hand does not imply a testimonial.
shots.continuity_in: Calendar begins with all doors intact.
shots.continuity_out: One door remains open and the first figure joins the collection.
shots.capability_need: Reference-consistent door motion, hand interaction, and figure identity.

shots.visual_purpose: Show the ritual repeating on another morning with a different figure.
shots.visual_action: A second numbered door opens and reveals a visibly different page-consistent dinosaur.
shots.framing_composition: Matched close-up with a changed door number and figure.
shots.continuity_in: Preserve the first open door and first figure from S05.
shots.continuity_out: Two open doors and two different figures carry forward.

shots.visual_purpose: Complete the quick reveal pattern and reinforce variety.
shots.visual_action: A third door-reveal moment resolves on three visibly different figures together.
shots.framing_composition: Fast close reveal ending on a small three-figure lineup.
shots.continuity_in: Preserve the two open doors and two figures from S06.
shots.continuity_out: Three-figure lineup becomes the starting state for collection growth.
shots.capability_need: Reference consistency across calendar state and three figures.

shots.visual_purpose: Visualize the collection accumulating morning by morning.
shots.voiceover_mapping: Morning by morning, the collection grows, all the way to day twenty-four.
shots.visual_action: Editor-controlled increments expand the lineup from the three revealed figures into a larger page-consistent collection without claiming an unsupported intermediate count.
shots.framing_composition: Stable tabletop or display composition that leaves room for the collection to expand.
shots.claim_proof_note: PAGE-CLEARED 24-day and 24-figure accumulation; intermediate counts remain illustrative rather than labeled.
shots.continuity_in: Begins from the three figures shown in S07.
shots.continuity_out: Expanded lineup prepares the complete-collection promise.
shots.capability_need: Editor compositing with figure identity preservation.

shots.visual_purpose: Land the day-24 collection payoff and no-repeat memory.
shots.visual_action: Resolve on a complete page-consistent 24-figure lineup if that source is available; otherwise hold a clearly growing collection without fabricating unseen figures.
shots.framing_composition: Orderly collection overview with each shown figure legible enough to appear distinct.
shots.claim_proof_note: PAGE-CLEARED 24 unique figures; the visual cannot invent missing figure designs.
shots.continuity_in: Continues the growing lineup from S08.
shots.continuity_out: Displayed figures remain available for the after-countdown uses.
shots.capability_need: Verified full-lineup asset or truthful collection composition.

shots.visual_purpose: Show the figures retaining value through collecting, display, and play.
shots.voiceover_mapping: After the countdown, collect them, display them, play with them, or hang them as dinosaur Christmas ornaments.

shots.framing_composition: Three clear use panels or a simple sequential layout with product-first emphasis.
shots.claim_proof_note: PAGE-CLEARED collecting, display, and play benefits.
shots.continuity_in: Uses the same figure identities established in the collection sequence.
shots.continuity_out: One figure transitions toward the ornament-use context.
shots.capability_need: Editor compositing; no customer reaction generation required.

shots.visual_purpose: Show the page-cleared dinosaur Christmas ornament use.

shots.claim_proof_note: PAGE-CLEARED ornament-use claim; the physical mechanism must remain faithful to the supplied source.

shots.continuity_out: Seasonal styling transitions into the offer product hero.

shots.claim_proof_note: VERIFY BEFORE LAUNCH — current single-item price snapshot; no free-shipping implication on the single item.
shots.continuity_in: Same calendar and figures used throughout the storyboard.
shots.continuity_out: Product remains on screen while policy overlays change.

shots.visual_action: Editor-owned shipping and return copy replaces the price overlay while the same product hero remains stable.
shots.framing_composition: Stable hero composition with policy text prioritized for readability.
shots.claim_proof_note: USER-APPROVED business defaults; the $49 threshold must remain attached to free standard shipping.

shots.claim_proof_note: CLEARED AIP continuation; no new claim.

continuity_map.product_identity: Use ASSET-R01 as the master calendar reference and ASSET-R03 as the master figure reference; do not redesign packaging, colors, layout, numbering, or figure appearance.
continuity_map.collection_progression: Three distinct figures at S07 expand through S08; S09 shows all 24 only when a faithful full-lineup source exists.
continuity_map.repeated_human_element: If a hand appears in S05-S07, keep its general appearance and direction of interaction consistent; it remains a generic production element, not a customer.
continuity_map.seasonal_style: Carry the same December light and restrained seasonal color treatment from S01-S02 into S11-S12.
continuity_map.commercial_copy: Render price, free-shipping threshold, returns, and any logo as editable overlays rather than generated in-scene text.
continuity_map.aip_transition: S14 must match the AIP opening state: the same calendar, one closed numbered door, and a clear tap target.
